scope: Editorial targeting hypotheses, not verified customer research or country rankings

segments.audience: Freelancers preparing keyword recommendations for client websites
segments.problem_hypothesis: Turning keyword estimates into a defensible shortlist within a small tool budget
segments.message: Record intent, live SERP and uncertainty before selecting a keyword
segments.purchase_gate: Verify plan limits, billing commitment and whether the shortlist improves a real client deliverable

segments.audience: Creators and agencies delivering narration for client projects
segments.problem_hypothesis: Avoiding revision, licensing and export surprises after selecting an AI voice
segments.message: Approve a representative sample and delivery rights before buying
segments.purchase_gate: Match language, pronunciation, exports, client usage and revision allowance

segments.problem_hypothesis: A polished deck creates extra work when the client's required editable export fails
segments.message: Test the client handoff and full billing commitment before subscribing
segments.purchase_gate: Open an exported representative deck in the client's application; confirm seats and invoice

geography_note: US/English remains a selected pilot market. market-geography.json records August 2026 Similarweb vendor-domain top-five estimates captured October 5. These are proxies, not segment-specific buyer rankings; top_traffic_countries stays unknown. Traffic-scope wording in the source is inconsistent; GA operator traffic is not a buyer ranking.
distribution: Existing website and authorized fanpage only; no paid ads or unsolicited messages
